name: The Aegis Codex

attunement.text: by a creature with at least 1 level in Wizard

entries: Bound in dark blue leather with silver arcane glyphs glowing faintly along its spine, this tome radiates protective energy.
Arcane Distraction (Reaction, 1/day). When a creature you can see makes an ability check or saving throw, you may force it to reroll with a -2 penalty. It must use the lower result.
Arcane Barrier (Bonus Action, 1/day). You create a protective field around allies within 30 feet. While you maintain concentration for up to 1 minute, affected allies gain a +2 bonus to AC.
